body.x: Intel showcased an expandable open-platform robot for transportation at “CES (Consumer Electronic Show) 2016”, the world’s largest IT electronics and tech exhibition, which runs for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th in Las Vegas.The company introduced Segway’s hoverboard, which is a personal transporter similar to a scooter. Intel CEO Brian Krzanich rode this hoverboard onto the stage at the beginning of his keynote speech. It received much attention. This particular device is a self-balancing scooter and a personal robot. It resembles a hoverboard, but it transforms into a robot at the touch of a button.Furthermore, the Segway Robot is an expandable open-platform robot that can be programmed to perform a variety of tasks in a smart home environment. It features voice recognition and streaming video via a RealSense camera, which helps the robot maneuver around obstacles.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products.
